observation_method: Live official page DOM and screenshots in Codex browser; dated independent HTTP 200 HTML response preserved.
reference_basis: Current public homepage in the Canadian locale
public_deployment_comparison: Pending; saved browser permission blocks the deployed user-site domain. Its public audience setting is separately confirmed by native Sites API.
notes: The observed live hero auto-rotates. Title Y varies during transition and is not treated as a stable matching measurement.
The current source has seven campaign controls; its original ARIA slide label still says 13. This source inconsistency is retained rather than inventing six additional campaigns.

The black/white navigation is initialized by the official site's scripts and is reconstructed in the draft. The Wolverine ribbon uses the original embedded assets, with an official game-page link replacing its original immersive campaign overlay.
Five original SVG sprite sheets are stored locally because cross-origin SVG use references do not render reliably from a local or hosted draft.
